steps: Peel and finely dice the onion; mince the garlic cloves; dice the zucchini into 1 cm cubes.
Cook the rice pasta in a large pot of boiling water for 8 minutes, until just tender, then drain.
Heat the olive oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic; cook for 3 minutes, stirring, until softened.
Add the lean ground beef; cook for 5 to 6 minutes, breaking it up, until no pink remains.
Stir in the tomato paste, dried oregano, and salt; cook for 1 minute.
Add the zucchini, crushed tomatoes, and unsalted vegetable broth; stir to combine.
Simmer uncovered for 8 minutes, until the zucchini is tender and the sauce thickens slightly.
Add the drained rice pasta to the skillet; stir gently and cook 1 minute to warm through.
Serve warm. Makes 4 family portions; refrigerate leftovers in an airtight container for up to 3 days.
